messages.subject: Re: MSstats removes features with few measurements although removeFewMeasurements is set to False
parts:
Hi,

it seems that in your case 1-2 observations per feature only occur in proteins that have a single feature. They are removed based on the value of "removeProtein_with1Feature" parameter.
So in general case, changing value of this parameter would work.
However, there is an additional problem. We also remove features with few measurements while handling fractions and that is not regulated by the removeFewMeasurements parameters.
It was intended behavior, however it's clear that it's not the best idea here. I will update MSstats to change this, but figuring out the best way to handle it might takes a few more days.
You can either:
- wait for the update,
- run OpenMStoMSstatsFormat with MSstatsConvert extended workflow and change parameter "handle_fractions" in MSstatsBalancedDesign function to FALSE. This means pretty much running the internal code of OpenMStoMSstatsFormat with just that one parameter modified.

Kind regards,
Mateusz
